s01-money.observed_description: An open hand, palm up, over a rustic wooden market counter holds folded green banknotes and five silver and copper coins; a blurred market is behind. No readable lettering on the money; no price card, wallet or phone.
s01-money.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): cash in a hand reads as money at 180 px.

s02-buy-bread.observed_description: At the market stall the customer (long wavy black hair, mustard-yellow cardigan, brown shoulder bag) hands a folded green banknote to the seller (short dark hair, dark-grey T-shirt, green apron), who holds out a round loaf in a brown paper bag to her across the wooden counter; both smile. No price card; background signs are blurred.
s02-buy-bread.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): bread for money reads as buying bread at 180 px.

s03-buy-milk.observed_description: At the market stall the customer takes an unlabelled glass bottle of milk from the seller with one hand while her other hand passes him a folded green banknote under it; both smile. No price card or bread. A small blurred chalkboard in the background reads FRESH FOOD, as in the 5.8 photos of this stall.
s03-buy-milk.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): milk for money reads as buying milk at 180 px. The background chalkboard carries two English words that are not an answer to any card.

s04-pay-five.observed_description: At the market stall the customer puts folded green banknotes into the seller's open hand above the wooden counter; on the counter are a round loaf of bread and a white price card that reads $5. The blurred FRESH FOOD chalkboard is in the background.
s04-pay-five.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): money going into the seller's hand beside the $5 card reads at 180 px.

s05-pay-two.observed_description: At the market stall the customer puts a folded green banknote into the seller's open hand above the wooden counter; on the counter are an unlabelled glass bottle of milk and a white price card that reads $2. The blurred FRESH FOOD chalkboard is in the background.
s05-pay-two.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): paying beside the $2 card reads at 180 px.

s06-find-money.observed_description: At the market stall the customer holds her brown shoulder bag open on the counter and lifts folded green banknotes out of it, smiling down at them, while the seller waits with empty hands. The counter is otherwise empty; the blurred FRESH FOOD chalkboard is in the background.
s06-find-money.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): taking money out of the bag reads at 180 px.

s07-price-tag.observed_description: A round loaf of bread on a wooden market counter beside a large white card that reads $5; at the lower right a second white sign hangs on the counter front with part of a word in capital letters visible.
s07-price-tag.note: Rejected: the partly visible sign at the lower right appears to spell the word being taught, which would put a written answer in the Learn picture. The Learn card uses the existing 5.8 photo of the customer pointing at the $5 card instead. Not installed.

s08-bag-cheap.observed_description: A plain blue cloth tote bag stands on a wooden market counter with a white price card in front of it that reads $2; a blurred market is behind. No people or other writing.
s08-bag-cheap.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the bag and its $2 card read at 180 px.

s10-book-cheap.observed_description: A closed hardcover book with a plain red cover stands on a wooden market counter with a white price card in front of it that reads $1; a blurred market is behind. No people or other writing.
s10-book-cheap.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the book and its $1 card read at 180 px.

s12-same-price.observed_description: On a wooden market counter a blue pen lies on the left and a red pen on the right, each in front of its own white price card; both cards read $3. A blurred market is behind. No people or other writing.
s12-same-price.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): two pens with the same $3 price read at 250 px; the pens are small at 180 px but both cards stay readable.

s09-bag-expensive.observed_description: The same blue cloth tote bag on the same wooden market counter and background as the cheap-bag photo; the white price card in front of it now reads $20. No people or other writing.
s09-bag-expensive.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the bag and its $20 card read at 180 px; only the price differs from the cheap-bag photo.
